skills.name: Ratios and ratio tables
skills.key: Equivalent ratios come from multiplying or dividing BOTH quantities by the same number. Never add the same number to both.
tiers: complete a ratio table with a whole-number multiplier
find the missing value across a non-adjacent row (scale factor not obvious)
ratios with fractions (3/4 cup : 2 servings)
compare two ratios from tables in a context
skills.gen: Base ratio a:b with a,b in [1,12]; multipliers in [2,9]; T3 use halves/quarters.

errors.desc: adds the same amount to both parts

skills.skin: fuel to distance tables, missiles per sortie, pilots per aircraft

skills.name: Rates and unit rates, including complex fractions
skills.key: A unit rate is 'per 1'. Divide the first quantity by the second. With fractions, divide by multiplying by the reciprocal. Label the units.
tiers: whole-number rate: 240 L in 8 min -> per minute
decimal result, and 'which is the better rate' comparisons
fraction in numerator or denominator: 1/2 mile in 1/4 hour
fractions in both; convert units in the same problem
skills.gen: T1: divisible pairs. T2: 2-decimal results. T3/T4: fractions with denominators 2..8, results simple.

errors.desc: divides the wrong way (min per liter)

skills.skin: fuel burn per minute, km per liter, Mach per throttle percent

skills.name: Identifying proportional relationships
skills.key: Proportional means every y/x is the same number k, and (0, 0) fits. Check EVERY row, not just two.
tiers: is this table proportional? (yes/no)
find k from a proportional table
is y = 3x + 2 proportional? equations and words
which of three tables/equations is proportional and what is k
skills.gen: Build proportional tables from k in {2..12, 1/2, 1/4, 1.5, 2.5}; build non-proportional ones by adding a constant or breaking one row.

errors.distractor: yes for a table broken in row 3

skills.skin: fuel vs distance tables, missiles vs credits, thrust vs throttle

skills.name: Writing and solving proportions
skills.key: Match units to matching positions (top with top). Solve with y = kx, a scale factor, or cross products.
tiers: a/b = x/d with a clean scale factor
no clean scale factor; cross products needed
unknown in the denominator; decimals
context with a unit conversion or a two-step setup
skills.gen: Pick k and x first, compute the other values; T2 ensure the scale factor is non-integer.

errors.desc: adds the difference instead of scaling

skills.skin: fuel for a longer leg from a known rate, missiles needed for n bogeys

skills.name: Graphs of proportional relationships
skills.key: A proportional graph is a straight line through (0, 0). k is the y-value at x = 1, the point (1, k). The point (x, y) means 'x of this gives y of that'.
tiers: which graph is proportional (line through origin)
read k from a graph; find (1, k)
write y = kx from a graph; plot points from k
explain what a point means; compare two graphs' rates
skills.gen: k in {0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 4, 5}; grid 0..10; non-proportional foils have nonzero intercepts or curves.

errors.desc: swaps what x and y mean

skills.skin: fuel vs distance graph, altitude gained vs minutes, credits vs missions

skills.name: Scale drawings
skills.key: A scale is a ratio (drawing : actual). Multiply a drawing length by the scale factor to get the real length. Areas scale by the factor SQUARED.
tiers: drawing length -> actual length with a scale like 1 cm : 25 km
actual -> drawing; find the scale from one pair
area from a scale drawing (factor squared); scales without units (1:72)
reproduce at a different scale; compare two scales
skills.gen: Scales: 1cm:5km..1cm:50km, 1in:20ft, 1:48, 1:72, 1:144. Lengths to 1 decimal. T3 area problems use rectangles on a grid.

errors.desc: scales area by k instead of k^2
adds the scale instead of multiplying

skills.skin: tactical map distances, 1:72 model builds, hangar blueprints

skills.name: Fractions, decimals, and percents
skills.key: Percent means 'per 100'. Percent to decimal: divide by 100 (move the point two places left). Decimal to percent: multiply by 100.
tiers: whole-number percents to decimals and fractions
fractions with denominators 4, 5, 8, 20, 25 to percents
percents under 1% and over 100%; repeating (1/3 = 33.3%)
order a mixed set of fractions, decimals, and percents
skills.gen: T1 in [1,99]. T3 includes 0.5%, 250%, 1/3, 2/3. T4 five values close together.

errors.desc: moves the decimal the wrong way

skills.skin: shield and fuel gauges as fractions, decimals, percents

skills.name: The percent proportion
skills.key: part / whole = percent / 100. Identify the whole first: it is what the percent is OF.
tiers: find the part: 25% of 80
find the percent: 18 is what % of 60
find the whole: 15 is 30% of what
context where the whole is not the largest number stated
skills.gen: Choose whole in [20,400], percent from {5,10,12.5,15,20,25,30,40,50,60,75,80,90}; compute part; rotate which is unknown.

errors.desc: puts the part as the whole

skills.skin: percent of missiles fired, percent of the squadron ready, damage taken

skills.name: The percent equation (tax, tip, commission, fees)
skills.key: part = percent (as a decimal) x whole. Tax and tip are ADDED to the price; a fee can be a percent of a total.
tiers: a = p% x w with clean numbers
total with tax or tip added (price x 1.08)
find the percent or the whole from a total
multi-step: tax plus tip plus fee on a purchase

errors.desc: reports the tax as the total

skills.skin: base shop: missile price plus tax, hangar fee as a percent, pilot commission per kill

skills.name: Percents of increase and decrease; percent error
skills.key: Percent change = (new - original) / ORIGINAL x 100. Percent error = |estimate - actual| / actual x 100.
tiers: percent increase with clean numbers
percent decrease; decimals
find the new value from a percent change; percent error
two successive changes (up 50% then down 50% is not back to start)
skills.gen: Original in [20,2000]; percent from {5..90 step 5}; T3 estimates within 30% of actual.

errors.desc: reports the raw difference as a percent

skills.skin: top speed increase after an upgrade, fuel estimate vs actual (percent error), squadron size change

skills.name: Discounts and markups
skills.key: Sale price = price x (1 - discount). Selling price = cost x (1 + markup). A 25% discount means you pay 75%.
tiers: sale price from a percent off
markup: cost to selling price
find the original price from a sale price; which coupon is better
stacked discounts and the equivalent single percent; write C - 0.25C = 0.75C
skills.gen: Prices in [10,5000]; rates from {10,15,20,25,30,40,50,60}. T4 pairs like 20% then 10%.

errors.desc: reports the discount amount as the sale price

skills.skin: base shop discounts, black-market markups on parts, stacked coupons for paint schemes

skills.name: Simple interest
skills.key: I = P x r x t, with r as a decimal and t in YEARS. Balance = P + I.
tiers: I from P, r, t in whole years
balance after t years; months converted to years
find r or t from I
compare two loans/accounts over different times

errors.desc: reports I when the balance was asked

skills.skin: squadron credit account, hangar loan for a new airframe
